label: File
description: A file you keep, such as a PDF or a spreadsheet.

blob_ref.label: Blob Reference
blob_ref.description: A reference to the file's contents, written as sha256: followed by the hex digest.

mime_type.label: MIME Type
mime_type.description: The file's MIME type, such as application/pdf.

notes.description: Your own comments, kept apart from the file's details.

extracted_text.description: Text the server reads out of the file, such as document text or the words in an image.

executable.description: Whether the file may be run as a program. Absent means it may not.

size_bytes.label: Size
size_bytes.description: The size of the file in bytes, set by the server once the instance holds the file's bytes.
